findings.message: the pattern matches 3 of 5 sample lines. It must match every one: a line it misses is dropped entirely, not partly parsed. The capture before it, %{INT:pid}, matched only '10' and stopped at '] Oct 25 15:' - it is too narrow, and that is the one to widen. That position does not hold a bare number It also misses lines of other shapes: "[13] Oct 25 15:14:28 Bad password attempt for 'root' from 172.21.55.92:36838". If this line is a VARIANT of the others - an extra word, a field that is sometimes absent - make that part optional with (?:...)? rather than writing a second pattern. If it is a DIFFERENT KIND of message - different words, not one more of them - add a pattern for it to `alternatives`, reusing the same capture name for the same value.

findings.message: scenario r5_tomcat_json__holdout_01: the detection rule expected 5 matches but found 0. every field the rule needs is present in the documents, so the fields are being produced and the VALUES are landing somewhere unexpected. This is the case where a role is likely wrong: re-check source.* against destination.* against observer.*. the rule looks for http.request.method = 'GET'; the parsed documents carry 'GET /manager/text/list HTTP/1.1', 'GET /manager/html HTTP/1.1', 'GET /wp-login.php HTTP/1.1', 'GET /manager/text/serverinfo HTTP/1.1', 'GET /manager/status HTTP/1.1' - if those are the source's words for the same thing, translate them with a value map.

scenario r5_tomcat_json__holdout_03: the detection rule expected 1 matches but found 0. the documents carry user.name but never url.original. Those fields are declared in the mapping and absent from the output, so either the source key does not exist or the extraction is not reaching it.

the probe injected 'GET' as http.request.method, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The mapping reads http.request.method from 'request', so that key is not being extracted from the line: check `extraction`.
the probe injected 'HTTP/1.1' as http.version, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The parser dropped it.
the probe injected '/missing.jsp' as url.original, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The parser dropped it.
